contentPattern.structure: tabbed filter over an image+title+description card grid
contentPattern.tabsDerived: 'All' tab is derived automatically; author-provided tabs are the unique categories (Climbing, Cycling, Skiing, Surfing, Travel)

suitableFor: category-filtered listing grids (adventures, products, destinations) driven by a tab bar
'browse by category' sections where each item is tagged with one category and an 'All' view is desired
image + uppercase title + description card grids that need client-side tab filtering
notSuitableFor: generic tabbed content panels with arbitrary rich content per tab (use vanilla tabs)
destination discovery galleries without tabs (use cards-gallery)

contentModel.description: One block row per adventure card, 3 cells: [Category] [Image] [Title link + description]. Cells are matched by content (image cell has a picture, body cell has a link, remaining text cell = category), so exact column order is tolerant. The tab bar and the 'All' aggregate are generated by the block.
contentModel.example: Row: | Climbing | <image> | [Colorado Rock Climbing](/us/en/adventures/colorado-rock-climbing) With all of Colorado's beautiful peaks... |

dependencies.note: Self-contained. Does NOT import moveInstrumentation or fetchPlaceholders (this project's aem.js/scripts.js do not export them). Vanilla tabs.js was rewritten rather than copied verbatim for this reason. Keyboard accessible per WAI-ARIA tabs pattern (roving tabindex, Arrow/Home/End).
